summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Foreign Trade Bank of Latin America, Inc., a foreign private issuer, submitting unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. It contains routine financial results—balance sheet, income statement, and notes—with no mention of any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The report is an ordinary periodic disclosure of financial performance.
